english.title: Producer or authorised representative fail to join scheme within 28 days of date after reg 14(4) date

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer,]_
(B)_[an authorised representative of a producer,]_

failed to join a scheme within 28 days of **(..SPECIFY DATE..) that date being the date that

(C)_[you]_
(D)_[the producer]_

(E)_[put]_
(F)_[formed the intention of putting]_

EEE on the market in the United Kingdom and being a date by which you should have joined a scheme under regulation 14(4) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Regulations 2013
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(5), 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a producer / authorised representative of a producer
who did not place or form the intention of placing EEE on the market in the UK until after the date by which they should have joined a scheme under regulation 14(4)
failed to join a scheme within 28 days of placing it on the market or forming the intention of placing it on the market
